identitySignals: Agenda names 'Fulcrum Management, Inc. (Thoughtexchange)'; thoughtexchange.com legal pages name the operating company as Fulcrum Management Solutions Ltd. (operating as ThoughtExchange), a related entity with the same Fulcrum name
ThoughtExchange sells an engagement/survey software platform to K-12 districts, consistent with OUSD's 'Technology' category and a Thoughtexchange Terms of Service agreement
The company's own site lists public school districts such as Long Beach USD and Spokane Public Schools as clients (OUSD itself is not mentioned there)
research.notes: The agenda's Spokane Valley, WA location and 'Inc.' name point to the US entity (reportedly Fulcrum Management Solutions Inc., a Washington corporation), but the only legal page fetched (thoughtexchange.com/terms-of-use/) names Fulcrum Management Solutions Ltd., a British Columbia company at Rossland, BC. I could not confirm which entity OUSD contracts with, or confirm the Spokane Valley office on a fetchable page, so legal name, address and registry IDs are left null. Registry pages and several contract PDFs blocked automated fetching.

profile.summary: ThoughtExchange is a software company that provides an online engagement and survey platform, mainly for K-12 school districts. Organizations use it to gather input from their communities and to review the results over time.
